name: DCAT-AP
description: Extends the dcat module with the DCAT-AP 2.1.0 application profile: adds profile-specific base fields and enforces mandatory/recommended cardinality constraints on the dcat entities via DcatFieldProvider plugins.
project_description:
DCAT-AP extends the dcat module with support for the DCAT-AP 2.1.0 application profile (https://github.com/SEMICeu/DCAT-AP/tree/2.1.0-draft/releases/2.1.0).

It does not define any new entity types, routes, permissions, or services. Instead it hooks into the base dcat module's `dcat_field_provider` plugin system with three provider plugins (for dcat_dataset, dcat_distribution and dcat_agent) that contribute additional DCAT-AP base fields and alter existing base fields to apply the profile's mandatory/recommended constraints and vocabulary guidance.

Dataset gains version info, is-version-of, has-version, source, provenance and sample-distribution fields; Distribution gains checksum and representation-technique fields. The plugins mark DCAT-AP mandatory properties (dataset description and publisher, distribution title/access URL, agent name) as required and rewrite recommended-field descriptions to point at the relevant EU controlled vocabularies. An install hook calls dcat's schema-sync helper so the new/altered fields are written to the entity tables. Optional display config is shipped under config/optional/ and applied only when the matching base displays and the link/text modules are present.

Use this module when the base DCAT model is not enough and the catalog must be published as DCAT-AP compliant metadata.
